finding.status_at_f69: Source-level lifecycle defect identified; no browser runtime reproduction in this environment.
finding.observation: _activate stores the same MorphDatabaseBytes in _database and passes it to the transport; removeModel disposes the loaded worker and calls _activate with that cached object. The transport transfers the original Uint8List ArrayBuffers. MorphDatabaseBytes.verified makes an unmodifiable map but does not copy its lists.
finding.consequence: For JavaScript compilation, Uint8List.toJS casts without copying. Transferring detaches the retained buffers; reopening the base analyzer from those buffers after model removal can fail and lose base analysis. The session-only storage fallback cannot recover by reading persistent storage.
finding.resolution: Requires an explicit source correction or disclosed browser limitation; not relabelled as an author baseline exception.
